scope: F2 fold-0 screen. New feature block: Learned passenger similarity metric via Siamese/triplet network or metric learning on covariates. Uses the learned metric to generate k-NN or kernel features.

H46_LEARNED_SIMILARITY.question: Does a learned passenger similarity metric (metric learning on covariates) produce features that improve fold-0 OOF AUC when added to 21raw?
H46_LEARNED_SIMILARITY.method: Train a Siamese network / metric learning model (e.g., LMNN, ITML, or simple contrastive loss) on FIT folds to learn a Mahalanobis distance. Use the learned metric to compute k-NN distances or kernel similarities as new features. Cross-fit 5-fold. LGBM on 21raw + learned similarity features vs 21raw.
H46_LEARNED_SIMILARITY.leakage: Metric learning trained on FIT only (folds 1-4). Similarities computed for fold-0 using FIT-trained metric. Fold-safe.
H46_LEARNED_SIMILARITY.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
